response.text:
Both tests pass now.

The failing test expects a single number like `"7"` to be a span of one (`{from: 7, to: 7}`), but `parseRange` split on `"-"` and left `to` undefined, producing `NaN`. I changed the destructure to `const[from, to = from] = text.split("-")` so a missing upper bound defaults to the lower bound.
